verdict.rationale: monday.com's own materials say it can automate status updates and reports on a set schedule (monday-docs-21), and its developer platform ships cron out of the box (monday-docs-45). Event-driven workflow triggers such as data changes and board or user creation are also documented (monday-docs-27, monday-docs-46), and reusable workflow blocks can be shipped (monday-docs-44). missing for 10: in-depth documentation of schedule/recurrence configuration (intervals, time zones, recurrence rules), independent or hands-on corroboration of scheduled workflows.
